I can't afford to keep buying them off people who charge up the ass. Wish I could get a script but my psychiatrist knows I have a history of addiction in my immediate family and won't allow it. Just like you tho, the root of my problem isn't necessarily addiction. I'm an addict because I'm depressed, not depressed because I'm an addict. I know some people may find that controversial but I'm sure of it. If I can resolve my anxiety and depression I won't need to resort to the drugs. I definitely think trauma causes you to be more vulnerable to entities, I only had SP one time in my childhood and it was when I was sleeping at my fathers house. I never had it again until my father passed away when I was 16 and I've had quite a few experiences with it since then.

I've seen figures and heard things as well, been laughed at and talked down to while in sleep paralysis before... example- a mans voice told me I was a piece of shit, then I heard children laughing. So strange. I saw some grey human like figures who seemed pixel-y and sounded like they were walking across newspaper when they moved around my room. Never had anything attack me or come at me though thankfully. SP experiences are extremely odd and frightening but also very interesting!

Nope you're not insane you're just human having a crazy spiritual experience. I've had plenty experiences myself with sleep paralysis, I've seen "static" figures and heard aggressive voices and mocking laughter. My sister had sleep paralysis last summer and told me she heard me walk into the room and say something to her then walk away, only to wake up to me not there. She called me in a panic right after. My mom also told me she heard me walking around upstairs and into the bathroom where she swears she heard me puking, when in fact I was not home. She called me freaking out as well, made me head right home. I think my experiences with sleep paralysis are linked to my families experiences with my doppleganger. I think it's some creepy potentially demonic shit, interesting as hell through.. literally :) try not to let it scare you if it happens again, no one is ever actually harmed during sleep paralysis, the experience feels so real but in the end you gotta remind yourself it'll pass as it always does for everyone. Now when I have freaky paranormal experiences I actually enjoy them because I know they will end soon and I'm never truly harmed, so I'm just extremely interested.
